title: AI for Finance
tagline: Machine learning for markets and money: how quant firms work, portfolios and factors, honest backtesting, financial text, credit risk, and LLMs in finance. Education, not investment advice.
prereqs: Machine Learning and Python & Math for AI. Time Series & Forecasting helps.

steps.title: How quantitative trading firms work
steps.why: Market making versus market taking, and how quants turn forecasts into trades.

steps.title: Option pricing and the Black-Scholes story
steps.why: From Bachelier's random walks to Black-Scholes, hedging, and the rise of quant funds.

steps.title: Factor models: Fama and French
steps.why: John Cochrane on adding size and value factors to the market to explain returns.

steps.title: Portfolio optimization in Python
steps.why: Mean-variance weights built from estimated returns and covariances, so estimates drive results.

steps.title: Backtest a strategy in Python
steps.why: Code a simple strategy and replay it on historical prices with backtesting.py.

steps.title: Test a backtest against chance
steps.why: Permuting price changes and rebuilding price paths gives a chance baseline; passing doesn't promise profit.

steps.title: Why most machine learning funds fail
steps.why: López de Prado's seven pitfalls, including bad labels, leaky cross-validation, overfit backtests.

steps.title: Three ML trading strategies, end to end
steps.why: Clustering S&P 500 stocks, Twitter sentiment ranking, and a GARCH intraday signal, all coded.

steps.title: Financial sentiment with FinBERT
steps.why: Label financial text positive, negative, or neutral with a BERT tuned on finance.

steps.title: Credit risk modeling with machine learning
steps.why: Predict loan risk on German credit data, handle imbalance, and serve it with Streamlit.

steps.title: LLMs in financial advice and risk
steps.why: MIT's Andrew Lo on LLMs for financial advice and risk, and their current limits.

projects: Backtest a moving-average crossover with backtesting.py, then run a permutation test on permuted price changes to see if it beats chance.
Score a month of financial headlines with FinBERT and plot daily sentiment next to the stock's daily returns.
Train a credit-risk classifier on the German credit data, report precision and recall, and explain it with SHAP.
